prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence for most specific kinds of change remains thin, as only sign-in hints (sign_in, hint), finish new screens (finish, new_screen), and adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) have at least 2 tests.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) and new finish screens (finish, new_screen) were helpful as both included winning tests.
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) showed no positive effect, with one test having no clear effect and another performing worse.
Predictions were generally too high across almost all tests compared to noise-corrected results.
Predictions were too low for sign-in reordering (+1.5% predicted vs +6.6% noise-corrected) and the post-onboarding control guide (+1.2% predicted vs +2.2% noise-corrected).

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Finish First Interaction Playground Screen: Add a new interactive pet control practice screen immediately after home intro where users test hiding, dragging, and chatting with their desktop pet. (why: Support received multiple complaints about post-onboarding confusion regarding controlling or hiding pets, and lessons show finish new screens drive conversion wins.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Safeguard Guidance Hint: Add a reminder hint on sign_in instructing users to log in with their original auth method to prevent duplicate empty accounts. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported missing or reset pets after signing in again, and sign_in hints have proven effective in past winning tests.)
2: [home, redesign] Desktop Launch Waiting Screen Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout with notification alerts and desktop tray troubleshooting hints during setup. (why: Home waiting stage has a long mean time of 2336s, and 3 support mails cited pets failing to show on desktop or app launch issues.)
3: [finish, new_flow] Post Home Companion Controls Flow: Insert a dedicated companion controls guide step at the end of onboarding highlighting desktop tray and shortcut controls. (why: Users reported confusion post-onboarding regarding desktop controls (3 emails), and adding new finish steps has strong support in historical lessons.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection AI Pet Generation Hint: Display a hint on choose_path explaining the difference between pre-made pets and photo-based custom pet creation. (why: Choose path takes a mean 514s and 3 support emails reported issues with custom pet generation failing or looking wrong.)
5: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Upload Quality Guidance Wait Info: Provide photo quality guidelines and format hints directly on the upload_photos screen to prevent broken custom pet outputs. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel (60.9%) and support received 3 tickets about custom pet generation failures.)
6: [finish, copy] Home Intro Desktop Visibility Guidance Copy: Update home_intro text to clearly direct users where to locate their newly rendered pet on their screen or system tray. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing on desktop upon setup, and finish screen copy adjustments can set clear user expectations.)
7: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Profile Restore Reassurance Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that signing in restores existing pets and guards against progress loss. (why: 8 support emails mentioned lost/reset pets when signing back in. Clear sign-in copy directly addresses account loss anxiety.)
8: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Environment Progress Info: Enable time estimates and desktop ready notifications on the waiting screen while the desktop pet initializes. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s; progress info and notification options reduce drop-off during long renders.)
